resumen_basico: Spider-Man is a fictional superhero created by writer Stan Lee and artist Steve Ditko . The character is Peter Parker, a high school student from Queens, New York, who gains spider-like abilities after being bitten by a radioactive spider . His powers include superhuman strength, the ability to cling to surfaces, and a precognitive danger sense .

El personaje es Peter Parker, un estudiante de secundaria de Queens, Nueva York, que adquiere habilidades de araña después de ser mordido por una araña radiactiva. Sus poderes incluyen fuerza sobrehumana, la capacidad de aferrarse a las superficies y un sentido de peligro precognitivo.
